fullTextZH: 同学们，他们在做什么啊？
为什么有漂亮的女生在跳舞？
fullTextEN: Why are there beautiful girls dancing?

fullTextZH: 然后为什么这些女生都穿得这么少啊？
fullTextEN: And why are these girls wearing so little?

fullTextZH: 这些老人们，他们在看什么东西啊？
fullTextEN: What are these elderly people watching?

fullTextZH: 为什么他们都在大马路的旁边吃饭啊？
fullTextEN: Why are they all eating by the roadside?

fullTextZH: Bella老师要介绍的就是台湾最特别的办桌文化。
fullTextEN: Teacher Bella is going to introduce Taiwan's most special banquet culture.

fullTextZH: 就是当有人结婚，还是神明生日的时候，
fullTextEN: is when someone gets married or it's a deity's birthday,

fullTextZH: 我们就会准备很多食物来请这些参加的人一起吃。
fullTextEN: we will prepare a lot of food to invite the participants to eat together.

fullTextZH: 我们的办桌不是在房子里面，
fullTextEN: our banquets are not held inside houses,

fullTextZH: 我们常常啊会把办桌办在马路的旁边，
fullTextEN: We often hold banquets by the roadside,

fullTextZH: 你可能会看到红色的圆形桌子和红色的塑胶椅子，在桌子上面呐，
fullTextEN: You might see red round tables and red plastic chairs on the table,

fullTextZH: 也会看到这种粉红色的塑胶碗，还是塑胶的汤匙。
fullTextEN: You will also see these pink plastic bowls or plastic spoons.

fullTextZH: 就像我今天穿的衣服一样，
fullTextEN: Just like the clothes I'm wearing today,

fullTextZH: 他们坐的地方旁边可能就是厨房。
fullTextEN: The place where they sit might be next to the kitchen.

fullTextZH: 有时候你也会看到阿姨们忙着切菜，
fullTextEN: Sometimes you will also see aunties busy cutting vegetables,

fullTextZH: 然后你还会看到旁边有一个大的桌子，
fullTextEN: Then you will also see a big table next to it,

fullTextZH: 上面呢，都放满了准备上菜的食物。
fullTextEN: On top, it's filled with food ready to be served.

fullTextZH: 你还会听到阿姨们大声的喊着：借过！借过！借过！
fullTextEN: You will also hear aunties loudly shouting: Make way! Make way! Make way!

fullTextZH: 那为什么会有这些辣妹们跳舞呢？
fullTextEN: So why are these hot girls dancing?

fullTextZH: 是因为神明生日，还是有人结婚，
fullTextEN: It's because of the gods' birthdays or someone getting married,

fullTextZH: 那为了能够让神明们开心，
fullTextEN: So to make the gods happy,

fullTextZH: 我们会准备一些表演给神明们看，
fullTextEN: we prepare some performances for the gods to watch,

fullTextZH: 希望神明看了以后会很开心。
fullTextEN: hoping the gods will be very happy after watching.

fullTextZH: 大部分的表演可能是一些传统的表演，
fullTextEN: most of the performances might be traditional ones,
such as dragon dance, lion dance,

fullTextZH: 慢慢的，大家开始觉得这个没有意思。
fullTextEN: Gradually, people started to feel this was boring.
this is not good to watch.
The number of viewers is getting smaller and smaller,

fullTextZH: 慢慢的，就开始了有辣妹跳舞的这种钢管表演。
fullTextEN: Gradually, performances with hot girls dancing on poles began.

fullTextZH: 她们会穿很少的衣服跳舞，
fullTextEN: They would wear very little clothing to dance,

fullTextZH: 所以啊，就吸引了很多很多的人来看。
fullTextEN: So, it attracted a lot of people to watch.

fullTextZH: 大家看了也觉得很开心，

fullTextEN: of course also felt very happy.

fullTextZH: 就常常和办桌的时候一起出现。
我们会从一些冷菜开始，
fullTextEN: We start with some cold dishes,

fullTextZH: 那前菜以后呢，就是主菜，
fullTextEN: After the appetizer, it's the main course,
For example, the main course includes steamed fish,

fullTextZH: 你一定会知道这一道食物，

fullTextEN: which is Buddha Jumps Over the Wall.
You can often see Buddha Jumps Over the Wall.
As for Buddha Jumps Over the Wall,

fullTextZH: 有排骨，这些新鲜又好吃的食材。
fullTextEN: It has ribs, these fresh and delicious ingredients.

fullTextZH: 吃完了还有水果和甜点。
fullTextEN: After eating, there are fruits and desserts.

fullTextZH: 看到这里，你是不是觉得肚子很饿了？
fullTextEN: Seeing this, do you feel very hungry?

fullTextZH: 等一下我帮你打包回家。
fullTextEN: I'll pack it for you to take home later.

fullTextZH: 打包啊，就是把没有吃完的食物拿回家继续吃，
fullTextEN: Packing up means taking the unfinished food home to continue eating.

fullTextZH: 打包也是办桌很重要的一个部分。
fullTextEN: Packing up is also a very important part of the banquet.

fullTextZH: 常常办桌有剩下很多很多的食物，
fullTextEN: Often, there is a lot of leftover food at banquets,
In order not to waste food,

fullTextZH: 办桌的时候，你常常会看到这些阿姨们，才上菜就拿着袋子说，
fullTextEN: During banquets, you often see these aunties, as soon as the dishes are served, they take out bags and say,
Does no one want to eat this?
I want to pack it up!

fullTextZH: 好啦，这就是台湾特别的办桌文化。
fullTextEN: Okay, this is the unique banquet culture of Taiwan.

fullTextZH: 现在办桌的人好像越来越少，越来越少，
fullTextEN: Now it seems like fewer and fewer people are hosting banquets,

fullTextZH: 现在的年轻人好像也都选择去餐厅吃饭。
fullTextEN: It seems that young people now also choose to eat at restaurants.

fullTextZH: 我觉得一方面可能是因为办桌很麻烦，
fullTextEN: I think one reason might be that hosting banquets is troublesome,
You need to set up tents,
and also wash and cut vegetables outside.

fullTextZH: 另一方面，可能是觉得办桌不太干净。
fullTextEN: On the other hand, maybe they think banquets are not very clean.
The culture of hosting banquets is also slowly,
Banquet is not just about eating,

fullTextZH: 也是代表台湾人喜欢分享的精神。
fullTextEN: it also represents the spirit of sharing that Taiwanese people love.
I hope in the future, ah,

fullTextZH: 虽然办桌的文化慢慢的消失，
fullTextEN: Although the banquet culture is slowly disappearing,

fullTextZH: 我们还是可以用新的方法，让这个文化继续下去。
fullTextEN: we can still use new methods to continue this culture.

fullTextZH: 那也希望你会喜欢今天的这支影片。
fullTextEN: I also hope you will like today's video.
See you in the next video!
